name: status:needs-spec
description: no verifiable acceptance criteria - agents do not take it

name: status:ready
description: ready, can be taken (crew task next)

name: status:claimed
description: taken by an agent, work in progress (lease)

name: status:review
description: PR open, waiting for review

name: status:blocked
description: blocked, a human is needed

name: status:waiting
description: waiting for dependencies (after); crew task promote moves it to ready

name: status:done
description: done

name: tier:low
description: simple task - a junior model will do

name: tier:mid
description: regular task

name: tier:high
description: complex - senior model only

name: risk:low
description: one agent review, auto-merge

name: risk:med
description: agent review + tests for the criteria, auto-merge

name: risk:high
description: agent review (security first), merged first by hand, E2E required

name: priority:high
description: do first: crew task next hands it out before other tasks of the same owner

name: priority:low
description: do last

name: feedback
description: human feedback after testing the running app; the product lead triages it regularly

name: epic
description: a large scenario made of several tasks

name: crew:pause
description: EMERGENCY STOP: all agents stop

name: crew:question
description: a question from an agent to the owner of an area (crew ask); answered with crew answer

name: needs-human
description: only a human can decide this (scope, contract, product choice)

name: crew:idea
description: an idea someone suggested; the captain accepts it as a task or rejects it

name: crew:captain
description: the captain handover log: who acts as captain (crew captain handoff/back)

name: crew:digest
description: the pinned team status issue, rewritten by crew digest
